code_paths.purpose: Performs initial stateless validation of the transaction fields before any ledger access.
Performs stateful validation using ledger data, including permissions, asset checks, and destination checks.
Executes the transaction after all validations pass (not shown in provided code, but standard in XRPL transactors).
validation_points: Assumes all validation already performed in preflight and preclaim

code_paths.purpose: Checks for protocol feature dependencies before transaction is allowed.

flow: preclaim: used to look up LoanBroker SLE
preclaim: compared to vault asset, used in further checks
preflight: checked for nonzero if present
preclaim: defaulted to account if not present, checked for pseudo-account, used in asset transfer checks
transformations: Optional, defaulted to sfAccount if not present
data_flows.validated_at: preflight (nonzero), preclaim (isPseudoAccount, canWithdraw, requireAuth, checkFrozen, checkDeepFrozen)

flow: preclaim: used as default destination, checked as owner of LoanBroker
preclaim: compared to amount.asset(), used in canTransfer, requireAuth, checkFrozen, checkDeepFrozen

description: Implements the LoanBrokerCoverWithdraw transaction logic for the XRPL lending protocol, including preflight, preclaim, and apply steps for withdrawing cover from a loan broker's vault.

test_coverage_notes: Typical test files for this code would be in the unit test suite for lending transactions, e.g., LoanBrokerCoverWithdraw_test.cpp or LendingTransactor_test.cpp. Tests should cover: invalid LoanBrokerID, zero/negative/illegal amounts, missing or pseudo destination, non-owner attempts, wrong asset, frozen assets, and destination consent. Gaps may exist if there are no tests for edge cases like deep frozen assets, missing vaults (which is marked LCOV_EXCL_START), or protocol feature dependencies. Coverage for all validation branches should be confirmed in the test suite.

validation_architecture.framework: Custom validation logic, Ripple/XRPL transaction processing

validates: Amount must be greater than zero
Amount must be a legal net amount (asset/format check)
Destination, if present, must not be zero
Destination account must not be a pseudo-account
Transaction account must be owner of LoanBroker
Vault referenced by LoanBroker must exist
Withdrawal asset must match vault asset
Asset must be transferable from pseudo-account to destination
Withdrawal to third party must pass withdrawal checks
